title: Debug profiler header exposed
description: The response carries the X-Debug-Token header. Profiler tooling then exposes request timing, configuration, and internal state to anyone who holds the token.
remediation: Immediate: turn the profiler off outside development. In Symfony this is `web_profiler` disabled with `collect: false` in the production configuration; other frameworks have an equivalent environment switch. Durable: gate the profiler behind an environment check rather than a URL parameter, and add a deployment test that fails when the token header appears in a production response. Trade-off: you lose profiler data from staging-like environments, so keep a dedicated profiling environment instead of enabling it broadly.
limitation: Header presence check: the profiler may be protected by a firewall that the scanner cannot see.
